newsitem.title: FINLAND: BIG IN-HOUSE DEALS IN LASSILA & TIKANOJA.
newsitem.headline: BIG IN-HOUSE DEALS IN LASSILA & TIKANOJA.

text.p: Trade in Finnish plastic and cleaning equipment maker Lassila & Tikanoja was boosted by big in-house deals on Monday.
A total of 183,100 shares worth about 48 million markka in Lassila were traded, most of them at unchanged 265.00 markka per share, in-house by Evli Securities.
Evli declined comment on the deals.
Last Friday, Evli traded 40,000 shares in Lassila at 265.00 markka per share.
Lassila & Tikanoja managing director Juhani Maijala said forestry group UPM-Kymmene may have further reduced its stake in the group.
"I don't know whether they (UPM-Kymmene) have further lowered their stake," Maijala said, when asked about the seller.
No one at UPM-Kymmene was immediately available for a comment.

On September 20, Lassila said UPM's ownership in the group had fallen to 6.4 percent of shares and votes. Repola Oy, which formed UPM-Kymmene through the merger with Kymmene Oy, held 13.4 percent of Lassila's shares and votes on February 15, 1996.
Shares traded in-house by Evli on Monday account for almost five percent of shares and votes in Lassila.
